I need a new toilet bag, and I thought I would have a go at making one. These are the best looking tutorials I could find online. Any of them would do, but I like the one from instructables the best, and I have a soft spot for instructables anyway. See this tutorial I published many years ago.\
<https://www.instructables.com/21st-Signature-Photo-Book>

<https://sanaeishida.com/?p=16181>\
Sewing the corner seems awkward, and there is a lot going on with the whole thing being inside out with the lining.

<https://www.bayhillstudio.com/blog/free-tutorial-quilted-dopp-kit>\
This one is not ideal with the emphasis on quilted fabric. The design seems similar enough to the first one.

<https://mellysews.com/sew-box-zipper-pouch-dopp-kit/>\
I don't like the look of the four way corner on the first image.

<https://beckystern.com/2023/07/02/dopp-kit-bag-sewing-pattern/>\
I like the zipper instructions on this one, but it does have a lot of pieces. Great that they are publishing their pattern, but I wasn't imagining having to use a pattern.

<https://www.purlsoho.com/create/2014/10/16/zippered-dopp-kit/>\
This looks great but there is a lot of bias tape and room for error. I would have to be very accurate for the corners to meet up nicely.

<https://www.sailrite.com/custom-dopp-kit>\
This is just a video which I'm not keen on. I want pictures.

<https://peekaboopatternshop.com/our-blog/diy-dopp-kit>\
I am not sure about the sewing of the corners, I think the cutting of the extra first that I've seen on a couple will be better.

<https://www.instructables.com/DIY-Cloth-Dopp-Kit/>\
Yeah, let's try this one.
